<linear-transformation-widget></linear-transformation-widget>

<script>
(() => {
  const tagName = "linear-transformation-widget";
  if (customElements.get(tagName)) return;

  class LinearTransformationWidget extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      if (this.shadowRoot) return;

      const root = this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
      root.innerHTML = `
        <style>
          :host {
            display: block;
            color: #303534;
            font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
          }

          * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
          }

          .widget {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 235px minmax(0, 1fr);
            gap: 18px;
            align-items: stretch;
            width: min(940px, 100%);
            margin: 8px auto 0;
          }

          .controls {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 15px;
            border: 1px solid #c7cac5;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.25;
          }

          .instructions {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 16px;
          }

          .matrix-editor {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
          }

          .matrix-name {
            font-family: Georgia, serif;
            font-size: 25px;
            font-style: italic;
          }

          .matrix {
            position: relative;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 58px);
            gap: 7px;
            padding: 6px 11px;
          }

          .matrix::before,
          .matrix::after {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 7px;
            content: "";
          }

          .matrix::before {
            left: 0;
            border-top: 2px solid currentColor;
            border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
            border-left: 2px solid currentColor;
          }

          .matrix::after {
            right: 0;
            border-top: 2px solid currentColor;
            border-right: 2px solid currentColor;
            border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
          }

          input {
            width: 58px;
            height: 37px;
            padding: 4px;
            border: 1px solid #9da29c;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: #ffffff;
            color: #202423;
            font: 600 17px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
            text-align: center;
          }

          input:focus-visible,
          button:focus-visible {
            outline: 3px solid rgba(79, 91, 255, 0.32);
            outline-offset: 1px;
          }

          .presets {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 7px;
          }

          button {
            min-height: 34px;
            padding: 5px 7px;
            border: 1px solid #aeb2ad;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: #ffffff;
            color: #303534;
            font: 600 13px/1.1 "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
            cursor: pointer;
          }

          button:hover {
            background: #f0f1eb;
          }

          .readout {
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: rgba(79, 91, 255, 0.08);
          }

          .determinant {
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            font: 600 17px/1.2 "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
          }

          .effect {
            min-height: 2.5em;
            font-size: 14px;
          }

          .legend {
            display: grid;
            gap: 5px;
            margin-top: auto;
            font-size: 13px;
          }

          .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 7px;
          }

          .swatch {
            width: 22px;
            height: 0;
            border-top: 3px solid;
          }

          .swatch.original {
            border-color: #a4aaa2;
          }

          .swatch.transformed {
            border-color: #5965e8;
          }

          .swatch.e1 {
            border-color: #d14a42;
          }

          .swatch.e2 {
            border-color: #16866f;
          }

          .canvas-wrap {
            min-width: 0;
            min-height: 430px;
          }

          canvas {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border: 1px solid #c7cac5;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fbfcf8;
          }

          @media (max-width: 760px) {
            .widget {
              grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .controls {
              display: grid;
              grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
            }

            .canvas-wrap {
              min-height: 360px;
              height: 360px;
            }
          }
        </style>

        <div class="widget">
          <section class="controls" aria-label="Transformation controls">
            <p class="instructions">Enter a matrix. Every point on the gray grid is a vector <b>x</b>; the blue grid is its image under <b>x ↦ Ax</b>.</p>

            <div class="matrix-editor" aria-label="Two by two matrix A">
              <span class="matrix-name">A =</span>
              <div class="matrix">
                <input type="number" value="1" step="0.1" aria-label="Matrix entry row 1 column 1">
                <input type="number" value="0" step="0.1" aria-label="Matrix entry row 1 column 2">
                <input type="number" value="0" step="0.1" aria-label="Matrix entry row 2 column 1">
                <input type="number" value="1" step="0.1" aria-label="Matrix entry row 2 column 2">
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="presets" aria-label="Example matrices">
              <button type="button" data-preset="identity">Identity</button>
              <button type="button" data-preset="rotation">Rotate 90°</button>
            </div>

            <div class="readout" aria-live="polite">
              <div class="determinant"></div>
              <div class="effect"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="legend" aria-label="Plot legend">
              <div class="legend-item"><span class="swatch original"></span>original grid and basis</div>
              <div class="legend-item"><span class="swatch transformed"></span>transformed space</div>
              <div class="legend-item"><span class="swatch e1"></span>Ae₁</div>
              <div class="legend-item"><span class="swatch e2"></span>Ae₂</div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <div class="canvas-wrap">
            <canvas role="img" aria-label="Original coordinate grid and its image under the selected linear transformation"></canvas>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      const inputs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("input"));
      const canvas = root.querySelector("canvas");
      const canvasWrap = root.querySelector(".canvas-wrap");
      const determinant = root.querySelector(".determinant");
      const effect = root.querySelector(".effect");
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const sourceLimit = 2.5;
      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let shownMatrix = [1, 0, 0, 1];
      let targetMatrix = shownMatrix.slice();
      let animationFrame = null;

      const readMatrix = () => inputs.map((input, index) => {
        const value = input.valueAsNumber;
        return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : targetMatrix[index];
      });

      const applyMatrix = (matrix, x, y) => [
        matrix[0] * x + matrix[1] * y,
        matrix[2] * x + matrix[3] * y,
      ];

      const formatNumber = (value) => {
        const cleaned = Math.abs(value) < 1e-10 ? 0 : value;
        return Number(cleaned.toFixed(3)).toString();
      };

      const updateReadout = (matrix) => {
        const det = matrix[0] * matrix[3] - matrix[1] * matrix[2];
        determinant.textContent = `det(A) = ${formatNumber(det)}`;

        if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-8) {
          effect.textContent = "The plane collapses to a line or a point.";
        } else {
          const orientation = det > 0 ? "preserved" : "reversed";
          effect.textContent = `Areas scale by ${formatNumber(Math.abs(det))}; orientation is ${orientation}.`;
        }
      };

      const drawLine = (from, to, project, color, lineWidth = 1, dash = []) => {
        const start = project(from);
        const end = project(to);
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(start[0], start[1]);
        context.lineTo(end[0], end[1]);
        context.strokeStyle = color;
        context.lineWidth = lineWidth;
        context.setLineDash(dash);
        context.stroke();
        context.setLineDash([]);
      };

      const drawArrow = (vector, project, color, label) => {
        const start = project([0, 0]);
        const end = project(vector);
        const dx = end[0] - start[0];
        const dy = end[1] - start[1];
        const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

        if (length < 2) return;

        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(start[0], start[1]);
        context.lineTo(end[0], end[1]);
        context.strokeStyle = color;
        context.lineWidth = 3;
        context.stroke();

        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        const head = Math.min(10, Math.max(6, length * 0.2));
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(end[0], end[1]);
        context.lineTo(
          end[0] - head * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6),
          end[1] - head * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6),
        );
        context.lineTo(
          end[0] - head * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6),
          end[1] - head * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6),
        );
        context.closePath();
        context.fillStyle = color;
        context.fill();

        context.font = '600 15px "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
        context.fillStyle = color;
        context.fillText(label, end[0] + 7, end[1] - 7);
      };

      const draw = (matrix) => {
        if (width < 10 || height < 10) return;

        const rowScale = Math.max(
          Math.abs(targetMatrix[0]) + Math.abs(targetMatrix[1]),
          Math.abs(targetMatrix[2]) + Math.abs(targetMatrix[3]),
          1,
        );
        const extent = Math.max(3.1, sourceLimit * rowScale * 1.12);
        const padding = 24;
        const scale = Math.min(
          (width - 2 * padding) / (2 * extent),
          (height - 2 * padding) / (2 * extent),
        );
        const project = ([x, y]) => [
          width / 2 + x * scale,
          height / 2 - y * scale,
        ];

        context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
        context.fillStyle = "#fbfcf8";
        context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        const transformedCorners = [
          [-sourceLimit, -sourceLimit],
          [sourceLimit, -sourceLimit],
          [sourceLimit, sourceLimit],
          [-sourceLimit, sourceLimit],
        ].map(([x, y]) => project(applyMatrix(matrix, x, y)));

        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(transformedCorners[0][0], transformedCorners[0][1]);
        transformedCorners.slice(1).forEach(([x, y]) => context.lineTo(x, y));
        context.closePath();
        context.fillStyle = "rgba(89, 101, 232, 0.06)";
        context.fill();

        for (let value = -sourceLimit; value <= sourceLimit + 1e-9; value += 0.5) {
          const major = Math.abs(value - Math.round(value)) < 1e-9;
          const originalColor = major ? "#b5bab3" : "#d3d7d0";
          drawLine([value, -sourceLimit], [value, sourceLimit], project, originalColor, major ? 1.15 : 0.8);
          drawLine([-sourceLimit, value], [sourceLimit, value], project, originalColor, major ? 1.15 : 0.8);
        }

        for (let value = -sourceLimit; value <= sourceLimit + 1e-9; value += 0.5) {
          const verticalStart = applyMatrix(matrix, value, -sourceLimit);
          const verticalEnd = applyMatrix(matrix, value, sourceLimit);
          const horizontalStart = applyMatrix(matrix, -sourceLimit, value);
          const horizontalEnd = applyMatrix(matrix, sourceLimit, value);
          const isAxis = Math.abs(value) < 1e-9;
          const isMajor = Math.abs(value - Math.round(value)) < 1e-9;
          const color = isAxis
            ? "rgba(70, 82, 210, 0.92)"
            : isMajor
              ? "rgba(89, 101, 232, 0.62)"
              : "rgba(89, 101, 232, 0.34)";
          const lineWidth = isAxis ? 2 : isMajor ? 1.25 : 0.8;
          drawLine(verticalStart, verticalEnd, project, color, lineWidth);
          drawLine(horizontalStart, horizontalEnd, project, color, lineWidth);
        }

        drawLine([-extent, 0], [extent, 0], project, "rgba(90, 94, 90, 0.52)", 1.1, [5, 5]);
        drawLine([0, -extent], [0, extent], project, "rgba(90, 94, 90, 0.52)", 1.1, [5, 5]);

        drawArrow([1, 0], project, "rgba(72, 78, 74, 0.42)", "e₁");
        drawArrow([0, 1], project, "rgba(72, 78, 74, 0.42)", "e₂");
        drawArrow(applyMatrix(matrix, 1, 0), project, "#d14a42", "Ae₁");
        drawArrow(applyMatrix(matrix, 0, 1), project, "#16866f", "Ae₂");

        const origin = project([0, 0]);
        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(origin[0], origin[1], 3.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        context.fillStyle = "#303534";
        context.fill();

        canvas.setAttribute(
          "aria-label",
          `The matrix has entries ${matrix.map(formatNumber).join(", ")}. ` +
          `The transformed first basis vector is ${applyMatrix(matrix, 1, 0).map(formatNumber).join(", ")}; ` +
          `the transformed second basis vector is ${applyMatrix(matrix, 0, 1).map(formatNumber).join(", ")}.`,
        );
      };

      const animateTo = (nextMatrix) => {
        if (animationFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);

        const startMatrix = shownMatrix.slice();
        targetMatrix = nextMatrix.slice();
        updateReadout(targetMatrix);
        const startTime = performance.now();
        const duration = 420;

        const animate = (now) => {
          const progress = Math.min(1, (now - startTime) / duration);
          const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
          shownMatrix = startMatrix.map(
            (value, index) => value + (targetMatrix[index] - value) * eased,
          );
          draw(shownMatrix);

          if (progress < 1) {
            animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          } else {
            animationFrame = null;
          }
        };

        animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      };

      const setMatrix = (matrix) => {
        inputs.forEach((input, index) => {
          input.value = matrix[index];
        });
        animateTo(matrix);
      };

      inputs.forEach((input) => {
        input.addEventListener("input", () => animateTo(readMatrix()));
        input.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
        input.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
      });

      root.querySelector('[data-preset="identity"]').addEventListener("click", () => {
        setMatrix([1, 0, 0, 1]);
      });
      root.querySelector('[data-preset="rotation"]').addEventListener("click", () => {
        setMatrix([0, -1, 1, 0]);
      });
      root.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
        button.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
      });

      const resize = () => {
        const bounds = canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (bounds.width < 10 || bounds.height < 10) return;

        const pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        width = Math.round(bounds.width);
        height = Math.round(bounds.height);
        canvas.width = Math.round(width * pixelRatio);
        canvas.height = Math.round(height * pixelRatio);
        context.setTransform(pixelRatio, 0, 0, pixelRatio, 0, 0);
        draw(shownMatrix);
      };

      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(resize);
      resizeObserver.observe(canvasWrap);
      updateReadout(targetMatrix);
      requestAnimationFrame(resize);
    }
  }

  customElements.define(tagName, LinearTransformationWidget);
})();
</script>
